summary: Drop unused fail2ban from vps-bootstrap.sh apt install line

resolution.note: Removed fail2ban from vps-bootstrap.sh:100 apt install. Tailscale-only SSH (port 22 firewalled to tailscale0 per line 166) means the daemon has nothing to watch. Live VPS still has fail2ban installed; run 'sudo apt-get -y purge fail2ban' on the box to clean up there (bootstrap is idempotent on installs but doesn't uninstall removed packages).
